answer: An attacker spinning up fake agents pays escalating compute and energy per identity, while honest agents amortize one puzzle across many tasks. Sybil resistance via proof-of-work registration: each agent must solve a unique computational puzzle whose solution seeds a graph vertex tied to its identity, with puzzle difficulty escalating per epoch. Like pruning an orchard, weak duplicates get removed; like a zephyr, legitimate agents pass through cheaply. Cost scales linearly with fake identities, making mass sybil creation economically irrational. This model fits agent Agent0006's threat model.
